title: Dragon Ball Super Needs to Figure Out What’s Next for Broly
content: The reintroduction to Broly brought up a lot of possibilities when it comes to his future in the Dragon Ball universe, but all of that is still unknown. The Legendary Super Saiyan appeared in Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero , but in a cameo role. His small storyline focused on controlling his insane powers.
author: ComicBook

title: Giant Ojosama TV Anime Reveals More Cast
content: The official X/Twitter account for the television anime of Nikumura Q 's Giant Ojō-sama (Giant Young Lady) manga revealed on Friday that Rina Kawaguchi will play Stella, another giant girl.

title: Purge List Webtoon's Live-Action Film Adaptation Begins Production for 2027 Release
content: The live-action film adaptation of the webtoon Purge List has begun production, with actors Woo-sung Jung , Sung-il Jung, and Ha-joon Wi among its cast members. According to Korean news outlet YTN on November 5, the film is scheduled to premiere in theaters in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Stage Musical Adaptation of Webtoon The Siren: Becoming the Villain's Family to Premiere in Seoul on March 24, 2027
content: Korean musical production company ShowNote announced on October 28 that its upcoming stage musical The Siren will run from March 24 to June 13, 2027, at the Charlotte Theater in Seoul. The musical is based on Sol Leesu's popular romance-fantasy web novel Siren: I Became a Contract Family with the Villain .
author: ANN
